rules.pricing: PnL counts only swaps in pools quoted in SOL, USDC or USDT (direct USD); a position with more than 10 % of its amount traded through pools quoted in another token is left out (unpriced)
rules.averageCost: realized = sold amount (up to what was bought in the window) × (average sell − average buy); tokens bought before the window are not priced
rules.suspect: a position returning more than 1000× its cost, or one sell above $1,000,000 into a token whose deepest pool now holds less than 1/20 of it, is left out; a wallet whose profit came mostly from such positions is left out
rules.cadence: more than 500 swaps on any day
rules.sniper: more than 150 tokens on any day
rules.burst: 8+ transactions inside one minute, in 3+ different minutes
rules.sameslot: 5+ sells within 2 s of buying the same token (sandwich / bundle / launch sniper)
rules.arb: 10+ transactions (and 20 %+ of all) that buy and sell the same token
rules.cluster: wallets that made their first buy of the same 3+ tokens within 2 s of each other are one operator: only the best score stays (siblings on its row, checked.clustered)
rules.scalp: median hold under 60 s over 5+ closed positions (sold before anyone could follow)
rules.launch: 3+ closed positions, and at least half of them, first bought within 2 s of that pool's first swap (creator / bundle wallet)
rules.eligibility: volume ≥ $2000, ≥ 5 tokens bought and sold, ≥ 10 swaps, realized ≥ $1000, win rate ≥ 30 %
rules.score: realized × (0.35 + 0.65 × win rate shrunk toward 50 % with 20 phantom positions) × (0.5 + 0.5 × profitable days / active days) × (0.5 when one token made > 80 % of the profit, 0.75 when > 60 %) × exp(−hours since last trade / 48)
